name: Cawley Road Building Two (MEL05)

address.note: Hobsons Bay permit PA220411 ('Use and development of a data centre (Utility Installation)') at this address; OSM building 'Microsoft MEL05' carries the same address and links this permit. Master.csv had 20-28 Cawley Road, Yarraville (the MEL04 lot on the same Microsoft landholding)

lat.note: geocoded: centroid of OSM building "Microsoft MEL05" (addr 385-397 Francis Street, Brooklyn 3012)

builder.note: Microsoft names Kapitol Group as Cawley Road general contractor; Kapitol page 'Yarraville Data Centre Melbourne 2' (client undisclosed) shows 'Under Construction', undated; OSM links that page to MEL05

mw_it.note: Microsoft does not publish MW per building

cost_aud_m.note: The Urban Developer $150m figure relates to MEL4 only; MEL5 described as a larger facility to be lodged later

authority.note: register does not name the applicant; linked to MEL05 by address/OSM (earlier expectation of a City of Maribyrnong lodgement, source 2, superseded)

pathway.note: Clause 33.01 (Industrial 1 Zone) use and staged buildings and works

reference.note: amendment PA220411-1 lodged 23 Jul 2025, amended permit issued 21 Jan 2026 (Special Building Overlay trigger, Melbourne Water conditions)

construction_start.note: campus groundbreaking 5 Dec 2022 (source 5) predates the MEL05 permit (17 Feb 2023); construction management plan endorsed 11 Apr 2023 (source 8); building-specific start not found

construction_end.note: Microsoft Feb 2025: 'The structural work for Building Two is now complete and crews are now focused on finalising building fit-out works'; Baxtel lists MEL5 as operational, year 2025 (source 9); Kapitol page still 'Under Construction'

open_questions: status operational vs still in fit-out: Microsoft has no update on Building Two after Feb 2025; Baxtel says operational 2025
permit applicant not shown on register; Microsoft attribution rests on location and OSM
